entry.name: jit.gl.asyncread
entry.digest: Read back from an OpenGL framebuffer
entry.description: Uses Pixel Buffer Objects (PBOs) to perform asynchronous reads of the OpenGL context at high framerates. The performance gain comes from using two pixel buffer objects in tandem to amortize the cost of the read operation over time without blocking other rendering commands from executing as is typically the case when naive methods are used.
